summary: Verified 2 bug fixes + auth regressions on public/admin frontend. All targeted scenarios PASS: (1) Public navbar no longer shows an 'Admin Panel' button/link even when logged in as admin — only nav-user-name ('Admin') + nav-logout-btn are visible; nav-admin-link count is 0 and the header text contains no 'Admin Panel' string. (2) Password show/hide toggles work on /login (auth-password-toggle: password->text->password), /register (auth-password-toggle: password->text), and /admin/login (admin-login-password-toggle: password->text->password). Regressions: admin login with ssnexoratech.19@gmail.com/Sipayi@143 lands on /admin with all 10 tabs (overview, courses, internships, media, feedback, enrollments, applications, contacts, users, settings) present. Regular user register+login works; Feedback nav link visible only when logged in. Non-admin credentials on /admin/login are rejected with the expected message 'This portal is for administrators only...' and the user is not granted access (URL stays on /admin/login, session cleared).
critical_code_review_comments: Mobile nav (Navbar.js line 95-97) still renders an 'Admin Panel' link for admin users in the hamburger menu. Desktop navbar was cleaned but the mobile branch was missed. If the user requirement is 'never show Admin Panel anywhere on the public navbar', remove this block too.
seed_data_creation: Registered one throwaway user navtest_<random>@example.com / Test@123 to exercise register+login+non-admin admin-portal rejection. Not deleted (no user-delete-self endpoint used).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both bug fixes verified on desktop viewport (1920x1080). Only outstanding item: Navbar.js mobile menu (lines 95-97) still shows 'Admin Panel' link for admin role. Consider removing to fully satisfy 'never show Admin Panel in public navbar' requirement. Password toggles use lucide Eye/EyeOff icons and correctly flip input type attribute.
rca_of_the_issue: n/a — no failures found in targeted scope.
